protocol.name: polo_test_v1
protocol.description:
Lets integration tests inspect Polo's window model and inject input. Compiled only with -Dtest-protocol=true and advertised only when Polo runs with --test-mode. Never part of a release build.
Window state is reported from Polo's own model (the Vala side), so tests check policy decisions rather than libweston internals.

request.name: get_window_info

description.summary: ask for a window_info or window_unknown event

request.description: Polo answers with exactly one window_info or window_unknown event for this surface.

event.name: window_info

description.summary: what Polo's model knows about a window

event.description: Geometry is the window geometry (xdg_surface.set_window_geometry) in global logical coordinates. layer is a PoloBackendLayerKind, stack_index counts from the bottom of that layer, workspace is -1 until workspaces exist, state is a Polo.WindowState bit mask and focused is 1 when the window has keyboard focus.

description.summary: move the seat's pointer to a global position

request.name: disable_output

description.summary: switch an output off without disconnecting it

request.description: Like a layout that turns the monitor off. A later configure_output enables it again; re-enabling it previously triggered a crash.

request.name: get_layer_surface_info

description.summary: ask for a layer_surface_info or layer_surface_unknown event

request.description: Polo answers with exactly one layer_surface_info or layer_surface_unknown event for this surface. Position is the surface's view origin in global logical coordinates, size the actual surface size and layer the zwlr_layer_shell_v1.layer value.

request.name: set_setting
request.description: Polo writes value, a GVariant in text form, to key of schema, and then answers with a setting event. Only when GSettings uses the memory backend; otherwise nothing is written and the value in the event is empty.

request.name: gesture

description.summary: a touchpad gesture, as libinput reports it

request.description: Kind: 0 swipe, 1 pinch, 2 hold. Phase: 0 begin, 1 update, 2 end.

event.name: setting

description.summary: a key's value, in GVariant text form

event.description: Empty when the key or schema does not exist or cannot be written.

request.name: shell_ui_samples

description.summary: send one of each polo_shell_ui_v1 event

request.description: Polo sends, if polo-shell-ui is bound: switcher_entry 1 "One" (app_id "one") and 2 "Two" (no app_id, hidden), show_switcher on output 0 selecting 2, update_selected 1, hide_switcher, window_menu_workspace 0 "Workspace 1" and 1 "Workspace 2", show_window_menu 7 on output 0 at 10,20 with ops 0x3ffff, insensitive 0x2 (minimize), active workspace 1 of 2, hide_window_menu 7, show_osd workspace on output 0 "Workspace 2" value -1, show_dialog 3 not_responding on output 0 "Hung", and hide_dialog 3.

request.name: shell_ui_dialog

description.summary: show a polo-shell-ui dialog on output 0

request.description: polo_shell_ui_v1.show_dialog with this id, kind and payload; its response comes back as shell_ui_request.

event.name: shell_ui_request
event.description: "menu_action WINDOW OP WORKSPACE", "dialog_response ID RESPONSE TEXT" (TEXT "(null)" when absent) or "color_table FIRST LAST", the first and last floats printed with %g.

request.name: shell_ui_lookup_color

description.summary: ask polo-shell-ui for a GTK theme colour

request.description: The custom_color reply is forwarded as shell_ui_request "custom_color NAME R G B A" or "custom_color NAME none".

request.name: output_device_changed

description.summary: report new monitor information for an output

request.description: Marks the output's head changed, as the DRM backend does after its connector information changes, including a virtual machine resize.

request.name: get_lamp_target

description.summary: ask where the window's Magic Lamp would go

request.description: Polo answers with one lamp_target or window_unknown event.

event.name: lamp_target

description.summary: the Magic Lamp target if the window minimised now

event.description: The target rectangle in global logical coordinates; edge is a Polo.Policy.LampEdge (0 bottom, 1 top, 2 left, 3 right) and source a Polo.Effects.LampSource (0 panel button, 1 X icon geometry, 2 pointer).
